firstDivergence.tapDisplay: TARGET presentation reflow immediately after click: wrapped status feedback increased the auto-height intro block and moved the rendered image after the physical click was captured.
firstDivergence.storedCoordinates: No divergence found; normalized source-image coordinates remained invariant through RESULT, SEC, Vault, and exact reopen.
firstDivergence.530Classification: Registered Bull 1-5 geometry used a generic 3-top/2-bottom layout that did not match the preserved 530 face's 2-top/1-middle/2-bottom layout.

rootCause.tapDisplay: Rendered image bounds changed after the click because the status element above the target had content-dependent height; the overlay correctly followed the moved image, so it no longer occupied the original screen point.
rootCause.530Classification: Implementation registration defect in one contract, not a Homie semantic-treatment defect and not a stored-coordinate defect.
rootCause.falsePriorPass: The prior coordinate test asserted numeric lifecycle equality and generated test observations from the same registered geometry. It never compared a real browser click to the post-feedback rendered image, and it could not independently challenge malformed 530 registration.

repair.presentation: Fixed the status block height so feedback text cannot reposition the rendered target; normalization and overlays continue to use actual rendered image bounds.
repair.registration530: Replaced only Bull 1-5 extents with pixel-measured outer extents from the preserved 500x746 source face; identities, capability, labels, and semantics are unchanged.
repair.verification: Added real-browser click/projection checks at narrow and desktop widths across the two Founder targets plus aspect-ratio extremes, and an independent 10-tap 530 replay through exact reopen.
